issues.what: it is meant to be low, just above the flippers, with a flipper catching the ball at the last moment. It is a high three-quarter view of the whole Street tier instead. The ball sits mid-lane and no flipper is near it, so the save does not read.
issues.fix: drop the camera to just above the flipper line, look up the table, and frame one flipper and the ball at the point of contact so they fill the lower third

issues.what: a plain tower block fills the right half of the frame. No lobby doors can be told apart, so 'the ball at the lobby doors as they slam' cannot be read.
issues.fix: move the camera off-axis so the tower sits at the top or side, add placeholder door slabs either side of the ball, and keep the ball centred with the doors framing it

issues.what: it is meant to be over the ball on the wire ramp with the cursor inside the ball. The ball sits on the flat playfield with the ramp behind it, and the cursor sits on top of the ball, not inside it.
issues.fix: put the ball on the ramp rails, frame the rails running ahead of it, and place the cursor inside the semi-transparent ball

issues.what: a dark block stands in front of the 'THE DAILY GRIND' title board and hides most of it. The whole-machine view loses its title.
issues.fix: raise the camera or move the block so the full title board shows above the Corporate tier

issues.where: frames 0:14.53 to 0:14.90, middle of the form
issues.what: two or three cursors show at once as the page settles. That reads as a mistake, not one user's pointer.
issues.fix: show only one cursor from the first frame of the beat

issues.where: the keyboard, all frames of beat 2
issues.what: the dark blobs, streaks and arm-like shapes from the two round pads do not show what is happening to the keys. Beat 2 cannot be read from the placeholders, and it runs a full 8 s for one word.
issues.fix: give the action a clear placeholder, such as visible arms pressing one key at a time with the key lighting up, and cut the beat to about 5 s

issues.what: the resume hangs over the shredder in almost the same pose for about 4 s before it is drawn in. The beat stalls.
issues.fix: cut the hold to about 1.5 s, or make the resume visibly sink a step at a time into the slot

issues.where: small helper text beside 'First name' and above the keyboard ('Minimum 3 characters required', 'Physical keyboards are not supported...')
issues.what: at delivery size these lines are too small and faint to read, but they carry the jokes
issues.fix: raise them to at least body-caption size with stronger contrast, and give the keyboard notice its own line with space above the keyboard

issues.what: the toast drifts over the Backspace key and the email field and leaves trailing lines at 0:33.07, so where it is anchored is unclear
issues.fix: anchor the toast to one fixed place, right under the email field and clear of the keyboard, and animate only its opacity or a short slide

issues.where: page at rest with no keyboard, frames 0:43.27 to 0:45.30
issues.what: all the content sits in the top half and the lower 45% of the page is empty, so the layout looks top-heavy
issues.fix: centre the form block vertically, or reduce the page height, so the space below Continue roughly matches the space above the title

issues.what: while the keyboard dissolves, a vertical seam line and floating key labels show
issues.fix: fade the keyboard as one group, or slide it down out of frame

issues.where: tier text labels such as 'Performance Improvement Plan' and the note cards at the lower right of each tier
issues.what: at map scale the labels are too small to read
issues.fix: enlarge the label plates on the map or label the tiers in a larger size
